Frequently asked questions

Which equipment do you support?

We work with servers, desktop computers, laptops, monitors, peripherals, and related equipment. If you are unsure whether we can help with a particular device, describe it in the enquiry form.

Can I request a quote before purchasing?

Yes. Describe the equipment you need and we will respond with a quotation. You decide whether to go ahead.

How are repairs assessed?

We begin with your description of the fault and diagnose the problem, then explain what we found and what we propose. You approve the work before it proceeds.

Can organizations request multiple devices?

Yes. Include the number and type of devices in your enquiry and we will prepare a quotation for the full requirement, including installation and setup if you need it.

Is on-site support available?

It depends on the work and where the equipment is located. Tell us where you are and what you need, and we will confirm what is possible.
